# Mystudionet Productions

> AI-powered video production studio based on Long Island, New York. We produce brand films, TV commercials, video ads, social media content, wedding films, and AI-generated video for businesses worldwide.

## What We Do

Mystudionet combines 20+ years of cinematic expertise with cutting-edge AI production technology. We serve businesses from Long Island to anywhere in the world — delivering high-quality video content on time and on budget.

## Services

- **AI-Powered Production**: Generative AI tools for concept, storyboard, scene creation, and post-production
- **Brand & Commercial Video**: Brand films, TV commercials, product videos, corporate content
- **Social Media Video**: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts
- **Wedding Films**: Cinematic wedding films for Long Island and beyond
- **Meta Ads Management**: Facebook and Instagram paid advertising
- **Google Ads Management**: Search and display campaigns
- **YouTube Ad Management**: YouTube pre-roll and in-stream ads
